## Author (submitter)

- [ ] **Intent** stated in ≥1 sentence (what should change / what readers should conclude).
- [ ] **`interchange` / RDE-style observation**: used—or **skipped with one sentence stating why**.
- [ ] **`kotonoha-spec` Issue/PR refs** filled when the prose depends on—or challenges—published spec obligations—or **explicit N/A**.
- [ ] **Unresolved backlog IDs**: cited only through **maintainer coordination** (never raw private-repo URLs in public threads)—or **N/A**.

- [ ] Normative-vs-informative boundary for this wording is coherent with filenames / placement guidance.
- [ ] Risks of **compression or metaphor drift** in public prose are surfaced (defer deep inventory to reviewer judgment).
- [ ] Merge / rework / fork into follow-up Issues is spelled out explicitly when discussion ends.
